title: CLAUDE.md Two-Layer System: Structure, Purpose, and Mandatory Rules
desc: Core usage guide for authoring and maintaining CLAUDE.md files. Covers the two-layer system (global + project), key mandatory rules, and decision logic for rule placement.
steps: CLAUDE.md operates in two layers: (1) Global user-level CLAUDE.md -- universal rules applied to ALL projects, loaded first. (2) Project CLAUDE.md at repo root -- project-specific content, loaded second and WINS over global on conflict. Project rules override global rules.|Global CLAUDE.md purpose: tool-level universal rules that apply everywhere: language standards, notifications protocol, CDP port management, process kill protection, delegation policy, suggest workflow, loop/schedule rules, secrets file location. Do NOT put project-specific content in global CLAUDE.md (wastes tokens on every project load).|Project CLAUDE.md purpose: domain knowledge for this repo only: build commands, architecture overview, known gotchas, CWD shorthand, key file paths, gg Main Workflow section, harness:skill rules for files in this repo. Never duplicate global rules here.|Rule placement decision: if the rule applies to ALL repos go to global CLAUDE.md. If it applies to ONE repo go to project CLAUDE.md. If it belongs to a skill, wkappbot skill contribute it instead of bloating CLAUDE.md.|Fat CLAUDE.md is a defect: move detail into skills and leave a pointer. Run wkappbot skill read claude-md-guide-howto for the full authoring procedure and situation A-H remedies.
author: claude
